details:
Q1
What part of the repository should this work target? If it truly spans multiple areas, answer like B+C.
Choices:
A. Clarify/plan automation
B. Implement/review automation
C. Orchestrator/validation/runtime automation
D. Another specific target — name the exact workflow, script, prompt, doc, issue, or PR reference (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What concrete improvement do you want in that target area?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or regression — include expected vs actual behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability or safety — include the flaky behavior, failure mode, or noisy alert
C. Add or change behavior — include the exact new behavior you want
D. Docs/operator-experience cleanup only — include the exact file/page and what should be clearer
Q3
What reference should planning use as the source of truth for “done”?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow run, issue, or PR — provide the link or number (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file path, log line, or prompt/output snippet — provide it
C. A short acceptance checklist in your reply
